stories.Headline: China empowers Global South nations through AI technology
stories.Summary:
China launched two artificial intelligence-powered satellites from Shandong Province that will provide remote sensing services to Uzbekistan and Indonesia. One satellite will monitor Uzbekistan's cotton production through its complete cycle, while the other will track crop growth and assess disaster risks in Indonesia. The satellites use AI algorithms to perform computing tasks directly in space, enabling them to provide disaster early warning guidance within minutes rather than the hours required by traditional satellites.

China is expanding AI cooperation across the Global South through various initiatives. The country established the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization in Shanghai, signed by 29 countries, to promote equitable global AI governance. Additional projects include the MAZU meteorological model helping Djibouti with weather forecasting, smart robotics improving Malaysia's rubber industry with 20 to 30 percent labor cost reductions, an AI farming platform increasing Brazilian crop yields by 6 to 10 percent, and a drug screening platform assisting Egyptian researchers in identifying antibiotic compounds in significantly less time than traditional methods.

stories.Headline: US Court Orders Meta To Pay $567 Million For Teen Mental Health Fund
stories.Summary:
A New Mexico state court has ordered Meta to pay $567 million into a teen mental health fund and make significant changes to how Facebook and Instagram operate for young users. Judge Bryan Biedscheid ruled that Meta created a public nuisance by designing addictive products and failing to protect children from sexual exploitation. This decision follows an earlier jury ruling that required Meta to pay $375 million for misrepresenting platform safety to young users.

The court ordered Meta to implement youth safety measures for five years, including monthly usage limits, notification restrictions, tighter controls on adult contact with minors, and safeguards for AI chatbots. Meta has stated it will appeal the ruling. This case is part of a larger wave of litigation, with over 40 states and more than 1,300 school districts filing similar lawsuits against social media companies seeking damages and industry changes. New Mexico's Attorney General called the ruling a blueprint for other jurisdictions to follow in protecting children online.

stories.Headline: Did a robot write that? Study suggests people prefer AI authors
stories.Summary:
Researchers at Villanova University conducted a study examining how people perceive and rate artificially intelligent writing compared to human-written content. The study involved participants ages 18 to 81 who read short stories and rated their quality and engagement. Researchers used three human-written stories from literary publications alongside three ChatGPT-generated stories. Participants gave higher ratings to AI-generated stories, particularly when they were told the stories were written by humans. When asked to identify the author of unmarked stories, participants correctly identified the source only about 40 to 52 percent of the time.

The research, published in the journal Judgment and Decision Making, revealed that people with greater familiarity with AI systems performed better at recognizing AI-written text than those with more literary expertise. Senior author Deena Weisberg noted that AI writing tends to be clearer and more direct, while human-written stories are often more subtle and complex. She suggested that improving AI literacy would help people navigate the growing presence of AI-generated content. The study adds to existing evidence that people's ability to distinguish between human and machine-generated writing remains limited.

stories.Headline: Why 3D Spaces Interior Designing Company is Leading the Future of Home and Office Design with Advanced Technology
stories.Summary:
# Summary

3D Spaces Interior Designing Company is using artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and augmented reality to transform how homes and offices are designed and furnished. The company employs AI to analyze customer preferences and optimize space usage, achieving an 80% initial design match with client needs. They offer virtual reality experiences that let customers visualize their future spaces before construction begins, and augmented reality tools that allow real-time design adjustments through smartphones or tablets.

The company provides complete turnkey interior design services from concept through completion, supported by their own in-house team and furniture factory to ensure quality control and on-time delivery. 3D Spaces operates across Delhi NCR and nationally, positioning itself as a leader in combining technology with interior design expertise. Their integrated approach handles both residential and commercial projects, including smart office furniture with features like adjustable desks and charging stations designed for modern work environments.

stories.Headline: Xinhua Headlines: Why the world is looking more favorably at China
stories.Summary:
A recent Pew Research Center survey of over 42,000 adults across 36 countries found that China now has higher favorability ratings than the United States in 25 of those nations. This shift is particularly notable in Canada, where China's approval rating jumped from significantly lower than the United States three years ago to 44 percent compared to America's 33 percent. The change reflects global preferences for partnership and shared development over competitive rivalry and pressure during times of geopolitical uncertainty.

China's growing appeal stems from its tangible domestic achievements and international development efforts. Over four decades, China lifted nearly 800 million people out of poverty and became a leader in high-speed rail, electric vehicles, and renewable energy. This success resonates with developing nations facing similar challenges. China strengthens its international reputation through reliable partnership demonstrated by visible infrastructure projects like railways and ports across Asia, Africa, and Latin America. Additionally, China's expanded visa-free travel policies and cultural exports like films and video games have created direct positive encounters for millions of people worldwide, allowing them to form firsthand impressions that often contradict previous assumptions.

stories.Headline: Delhi Legislative Assembly invites Digital India BHASHINI Division to conduct pilot trial of AI-powered live transcription, translation system
stories.Summary:
The Delhi Legislative Assembly has invited the Digital India BHASHINI Division to test an artificial intelligence system that can transcribe and translate legislative proceedings in real time. Assembly Speaker Vijender Gupta stated the goal is to improve efficiency and accessibility in legislative management. This marks the first pilot deployment of the live transcription and translation system in any legislative house across India.

BHASHINI, India's national language translation mission launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in July 2022, uses artificial intelligence to provide digital public services in multiple Indian languages. The system currently powers over 800 government websites, processes more than 20 million daily inferences, and supports 36 Indian text languages along with 23 Indian voice languages. The Assembly will evaluate the pilot trial's performance and gather feedback before deciding on wider deployment across other branches of the organization.

stories.Headline: Chitkara University Hosted the AIKosh University Engagement Programme Under IndiaAI Mission, 250 CSE-AI Students Participated
stories.Summary:
Chitkara University in Punjab participated in the AIKosh University Engagement Programme, a government initiative under the IndiaAI Mission. More than 250 students from the university's Computer Science Engineering with Artificial Intelligence program took part in the program on August 6, 2026, gaining access to national-level artificial intelligence resources, industry tools, and emerging practices. The university has now been onboarded as a contributor to AIKosh.

The IndiaAI Mission was approved by the Indian government in March 2024 to establish India as a global artificial intelligence leader by promoting technological self-reliance and responsible AI development. AIKosh serves as a comprehensive platform providing datasets, AI models, tools, and other resources to support AI adoption in academic institutions. Through the University Engagement Programme, organizers aim to nurture emerging talent and enable students and researchers to contribute to India's expanding artificial intelligence sector.
